We need to read the problem: Minimum Distance to Empty.

Truck: main tank fuel (mainTank liters), additional tank fuel (additionalTank liters). Mileage: 10 km per liter.

Rule: Whenever 5 liters of fuel get used up in the main tank, if the additional tank has at least 1 liter of fuel, 1 liter of fuel will be transferred from the additional tank to the main tank.

Goal: Compute minimum distance which must be traveled to empty the fuel tanks.

Interpretation: The truck uses fuel from main tank; consumption is from main tank, but additional tank can refill main tank when certain condition triggers.

Model: Truck has mainTank initially; as it travels distance, fuel used is taken from main tank. However, after every 5 liters consumed from main tank (i.e., after traveling some distance), if additionalTank > 0, then we transfer 1 liter from additionalTank to mainTank (increasing mainTank by 1, decreasing additionalTank by 1). This can happen repeatedly as long as the condition holds.

Goal: total distance until both tanks empty (i.e., no fuel left in main tank, and additional tank also empty? Actually "empty the fuel tanks" means we stop when no fuel left to be used. The truck only uses fuel from main tank; additional tank only provides fuel via transfers; after transfers it may become empty. The truck stops when main tank has no fuel and cannot be refilled (additional tank empty or insufficient for transfer). At that point, there may be leftover be unused? But if additional tank at least 1 liter, a liter after consumption triggers refill, as soon as there is fuel left in main tank, we keep consuming.

Thus we need to compute total number of liters consumed from main tank (including those transferred from additional tank). Then multiply by 10 km/l.

But careful: The truck consumes fuel from main tank only; when a transfer occurs, we increase main tank by 1 (so effectively we are taking 1 liter from additional tank and moving it to main tank, then later it'll be consumed). So total fuel used from main tank = initial mainTank + number of transfers that occurred (since each transfer adds 1 liter to main tank which will eventually be consumed).
